name: Penpie Pendle-market reward reentrancy
summary: PendleStaking.batchHarvestMarketRewards() had no reentrancy guard and credited reward-token balance increases during a market's redeemRewards() to that pool. The attacker registered a Pendle market with its own SY, re-entered depositMarket() from the harvest to deposit real Pendle LP, so Penpie booked it as rewards, then claimed them and withdrew its deposit.
notes: Permissionless registration through PendleMarketRegisterHelper was wired into PendleStaking before this upgrade, which re-selected the reentrant implementation; later real-market listings only changed which LP could be drained, i.e. the loss size.

Merged: about 50 minutes later the same attacker repeated the exploit against Penpie's Arbitrum PendleStakingSideChain 0x6db96bbe (implementation 0xc64b3f60, routed by 0xd7a6dbc9, age 8253869 s); that leg is a campaign entry and its LP carries chainId 42161.

Victims lost Pendle LP. DefiLlama prices the stETH, sUSDe and gUSDC LP from the yield token instead of the SY asset (10-18% high), so each LP is valued from its market reserves before the exploit: SY at its exchange rate plus PT at the implied rate, times the asset price.
